title: Federal write-in absentee ballot.
bodyText: A covered voter may use a federal write-in absentee ballot to vote for all offices and ballot measures in an election described in section 15D-3.
bodyHtml: [§15D-12]  Federal write-in absentee ballot.  A covered voter may use a federal write-in absentee ballot to vote for all offices and ballot measures in an election described in section 15D-3. [L 2012, c 226, pt of §1]
